title: PM to participate in Closing Ceremony of Birth Centenary Celebrations of Bharat Ratna Dr. Bhupen Hazarika on 29 November
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi will participate in the Closing Ceremony of the Birth Centenary Celebrations of Dr. Bhupen Hazarika at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, on 29 November 2026 at 6 PM. He will also address the gathering on the occasion. Dr. Bhupen Hazarika was born on 8 September 1926 in Sadiya, Assam. Fondly remembered as ‘Sudhakantha’ and the ‘Bard of the Brahmaputra’, he holds a special place in the cultural history of Assam and the nation. A legendary singer, composer, lyricist, filmmaker and writer, he gave voice to the aspirations and emotions of ordinary people through his creative works. Rooted in the folk traditions of Assam and the Northeast, his music transcended linguistic and geographical boundaries, bringing the region's rich cultural heritage to audiences across India and beyond. Beyond his artistic contributions, Dr. Hazarika was a humanist and social thinker. His works promoted equality, human dignity, social harmony and universal brotherhood. He also contributed to strengthening the cultural identity of Assam and enriching India's diverse cultural heritage. His exceptional contribution to Indian music, cinema and culture earned him several prestigious honours, including the Dadasaheb Phalke Award. In 2019, he was posthumously conferred the Bharat Ratna, the country's highest civilian honour. The Birth Centenary Celebrations commenced on 8 September 2025, providing an opportunity to revisit and rediscover Dr. Hazarika's contributions to music, literature, cinema and society. The celebrations also highlighted the relevance of his ideals, the timeless appeal of his creative genius and his message of humanity, harmony and universal brotherhood. ****** NKRM/SS/SS
